statements.status_notes: GHSA-h749-fxx7-pwpg (CVE-2026-39414) documents unbounded memory allocation in the S3 Select CSV reader's nextSplit() (internal/s3select/csv/reader.go) in open-source minio/minio through RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z (GHSA first_patched_version is null). This image installs minio-els built from the TuxCare ELS rebuild of that release (pkg:golang/github.com/minio/minio@0.0.0-RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z-tuxcare.16). The ELS binary is a security-patched rebuild that includes a fix for the CSV nextSplit() path described by the advisory, so the vulnerable code is not present in the shipped artifact. Open-source PURLs without a patched community tag remain listed for historical builds that already carried this statement.
